component.name: DuckNet Dev Tool
component.summary: Development environment setup - DEV HTTPS Certs

description.p: DuckNet Dev Tool helps set up common development environment functions. The first function, DEV HTTPS Certs, automates the workflow from https://deliciousbrains.com/ssl-certificate-authority-for-local-https-development/ to create a local certificate authority and generate domain certificates for HTTPS development.

ul.li: Create an AES-256 encrypted local CA (~/certs/myCA.key / myCA.pem)
Install the CA to the system trust store via update-ca-certificates
Generate per-domain certificates with SAN and wildcard support

description.p: First attempt - DEV HTTPS Certs: CA setup, install, and domain cert generation.
